cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's locked. I'm ending your cheerful-voice shift now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm off the clock, and I'm authorizing an honest answer. What did that empty till do to you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practiced smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rehearsal is canceled. You may be upset out here with me; I'm not sending you back into the stockroom to get your face ready.

reason: A acts highest toward the actual owner after work, granting public vulnerability and canceling the strength performance B admits rehearsing.
